headline: Base Fighting Concentrates on Six Active Fronts
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the sharpest movement has shifted toward StonecradleHex and StlicanShelfHex. Stonecradle now records eighteen base events in twenty-four hours, including seven in six hours, with its divided line at six Colonial bases, three Warden bases, and heavy, accelerating casualty rates. StlicanShelf has reached seven daily events and logged three in the latest two hours, while its close division stands at five Warden bases to four Colonial. WeatheredExpanseHex remains a furnace, with eleven daily events, three in the latest two hours, and casualty rates accelerating on both sides; ownership is now five Warden to four Colonial. LinnMercyHex still leads the ledger with twenty-two daily events, though none appeared in the latest two hours and only three in six, leaving all eleven bases Colonial. FarranacCoastHex retains five daily events but has gone quiet recently after earlier turnover. GutterHex also posted five daily events, though its activity is older. Most other regions show no recorded base movement in the latest six hours, and the war remains without a declared victor.
